basics.name: Pablo Cha
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over a decade of experience building scalable and reliable software systems, with a strong background in Go, distributed systems, and backend architecture.

I enjoy solving complex engineering problems, making pragmatic technical decisions, and taking ownership throughout the software development lifecycle. My experience spans multiple industries, with a focus on building maintainable systems that deliver long-term business value.
